messages.body:
**7. Create the charge, flip to charging**

Before this, `Reserve` (worker/worker.go:90) holds the stock; a sold-out line fails the order before anyone is charged. Then the charge is created at the provider (`Payments.Create`). A passing error puts it back to pending and retries later (:102-104); any other error releases the stock and fails it. On success the order becomes `charging`, message "Confirm the payment with your bank", and a deadline is set: the worker's `Timeout` is 20 min (cmd/shop/main.go:32).
